gloss: as one wishes; as one pleases

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; as one pleases; freely; to one's heart's content
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something exactly the way one wants, without restriction or compromise. Conveys a sense of freedom and satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いのままに{生|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to live as I please.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{何|なん}でも{思|おも}いのままにできる。
examples.english: He can do anything he wants.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{気持|きも}ちを{思|おも}いのままに{表現|ひょうげん}できる{場所|ばしょ}が{欲|ほ}しいと{思|おも}っていた。
examples.english: I had been wanting a place where I could express my feelings freely.

notes:
Composed of {思|おも}い (thought, wish) + の + まま (as is, unchanged). The particle に often follows: {思|おも}いのままに. This expression emphasizes doing something without constraint, following one's own desires or will.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}いのままに{行動|こうどう}する: to act as one pleases
- {思|おも}いのままに{操|あやつ}る: to control at will
- {思|おも}いのままになる: to go as one wishes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自由|じゆう}に: freely — more common and casual
- {好|す}きなように: as one likes — casual, everyday expression
- {意|い}のままに: at one's will — slightly more literary synonym
- {気|き}の{向|む}くままに: as the mood takes one — emphasizes spontaneity rather than deliberate will
